description: Flat metadata schema for records derived from co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry protein–protein interaction experiments in cancer cells, capturing experimental context, assay details, detection workflow, and identified interaction results.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or interaction observation.

dataset_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the parent dataset or study.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier for the specific experiment or biological replicate.

sample_id.descr: Identifier for the biological sample or lysate used in the assay.

cell_line.descr: Name of the cancer cell line used, for example 'HeLa', 'MCF-7', or 'A549'.

cell_type.descr: Cell type or lineage context if different from the cell line name.

cancer_type.descr: Cancer indication or tissue of origin, for example breast, lung, or melanoma.

oncogenic_mutation_present.descr: Whether an oncogenic mutation was present in the experimental system.

oncogenic_mutation.descr: Specific oncogenic mutation or variant, for example 'KRAS G12D' or 'TP53 R175H'.

bait_protein_name.descr: Name of the protein used as the immunoprecipitation bait.

bait_protein_accession.descr: Database accession for the bait protein, for example UniProt accession.

bait_isoform.descr: Protein isoform identifier or description if applicable.

interaction_partner_name.descr: Name of the identified interacting protein or candidate interactor.

interaction_partner_accession.descr: Database accession for the interacting protein, for example UniProt accession.

interaction_partner_gene_symbol.descr: Official gene symbol of the interacting partner.

experiment_condition.descr: Primary experimental condition, for example treated, untreated, mutant, wild-type, stimulated, or drug-exposed.

treatment_name.descr: Name of the treatment, perturbation, or stimulus applied to the cells, if any.

treatment_concentration.descr: Treatment concentration with units encoded in the value, for example '10 nM' or '5 ug/mL'.

treatment_duration_hours.descr: Duration of treatment or exposure in hours.

timepoint_hours.descr: Sampling timepoint after treatment or stimulation in hours.

ip_antibody_name.descr: Name or clone of the antibody used for immunoprecipitation.

ip_antibody_target.descr: Antigen targeted by the immunoprecipitation antibody.

ip_antibody_vendor.descr: Manufacturer or vendor of the immunoprecipitation antibody.

ip_antibody_catalog_number.descr: Catalog number of the immunoprecipitation antibody.

ip_antibody_species.descr: Host species in which the immunoprecipitation antibody was raised, for example mouse, rabbit, or goat.

ip_antibody_amount_ug.descr: Amount of antibody used for immunoprecipitation, in micrograms (ug).

ip_control_type.descr: Type of control used for the immunoprecipitation, for example IgG control, bead-only, or input lysate.

ip_control_used.descr: Whether a control IP or control sample was used.

lysis_buffer.descr: Composition or name of the lysis buffer used for cell lysis and protein extraction.

wash_buffer.descr: Composition or name of the wash buffer used during immunoprecipitation.

crosslinking_used.descr: Whether crosslinking was used prior to immunoprecipitation.

crosslinker_name.descr: Name of the crosslinking reagent, if used.

protein_input_amount_ug.descr: Total protein input for immunoprecipitation, in micrograms (ug).

cell_number_input.descr: Number of cells used as input for the assay.

ip_incubation_time_hours.descr: Incubation time for the immunoprecipitation reaction in hours.

ip_incubation_temperature_c.descr: Incubation temperature for immunoprecipitation in degrees Celsius.

mass_spectrometry_platform.descr: Mass spectrometer model or platform used for protein identification.

ms_acquisition_method.descr: MS acquisition mode, for example DDA, DIA, PRM, or SRM.

ms_fragmentation_method.descr: Fragmentation method used, for example HCD or CID.

ms_sample_preparation_method.descr: Sample preparation workflow before mass spectrometry, for example in-gel digest or on-bead digest.

ms_instrument_vendor.descr: Vendor of the mass spectrometer platform.

ms_run_date.descr: Date of the mass spectrometry run or acquisition.

database_used_for_search.descr: Protein sequence database used for peptide/protein identification, for example UniProt or RefSeq.

search_software.descr: Software used for database searching or peptide identification.

search_software_version.descr: Version of the search software used.

fdr_threshold_percent.descr: False discovery rate threshold applied during identification, expressed as percent.

peptide_spectral_matches_count.descr: Number of peptide-spectrum matches supporting the identified protein.

unique_peptides_count.descr: Number of unique peptides supporting the identified protein.

protein_score.descr: Protein identification or interaction score output by the analysis pipeline.

confidence_score.descr: Confidence value for the interaction or identification, on the scale used by the study.

quantification_value.descr: Quantitative abundance measure, such as spectral count, iBAQ, LFQ intensity, or reporter intensity.

quantification_unit.descr: Unit or convention used for the quantitative value, for example spectral counts, intensity, or arbitrary units.

fold_change_vs_control.descr: Fold change of the interacting protein abundance relative to the appropriate control.

log2_fold_change_vs_control.descr: Log2 fold change relative to control, if computed.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance value for differential interaction or enrichment testing.

adjusted_p_value.descr: Multiple-testing corrected p-value, for example FDR-adjusted p-value.

interaction_direction.descr: Direction of change in interaction relative to control, for example increased, decreased, or unchanged.

validated_by_independent_method.descr: Whether the interaction was validated by an independent method such as western blot, reciprocal IP, or proximity assay.

validation_method.descr: Independent validation method used, if applicable.

subcellular_localization_bait.descr: Subcellular localization of the bait protein in the experimental context.

subcellular_localization_partner.descr: Subcellular localization of the interacting partner in the experimental context.

pathway_annotation.descr: Biological pathway or process associated with the interaction partner or interaction network.

network_module_name.descr: Name of the interaction network module or protein complex, if assigned.

therapeutic_target_relevance.descr: Whether the interaction has potential therapeutic relevance for cancer progression or targeting.

therapeutic_target_note.descr: Free-text note describing therapeutic relevance, if any.

data_file_name.descr: Name of the raw or processed data file supporting this record.

data_file_format.descr: File format of the supporting data, for example mzML, mzXML, or tab-delimited text.

analysis_pipeline_notes.descr: Brief description of the analysis pipeline, filtering, or curation notes.
